reno.HasRenoAskedForKibble.description: Historical kibble request flag; also controls entry into Reno's kibble conversation branch. Temporary repair target.

reno.GotKibble.description: Reno's kibble receipt state. Preserved by the supported repair.

king_of_trade.BoughtKibble.description: Kibble purchase state checked by Reno's dialogue entry. Preserved by the repair.

reno.GivesYouUVsExitPapers.description: Paper handover state in the completed deal. Preserved by the repair.

reno.AlternateGoodByeAtEnd.description: Routes the post-kibble entry to Goodbye. Clearing it alone can replay the kibble scene; it is preserved.

reno.ReturnedHisModelTrain.description: Set by the game's train handover sequence. The repair does not simulate handover or set this flag.

reno.MissingTrain.description: One of the conditions for the ordinary train handover option.

orphanage.TrainRepairSuccessful.description: Successful model train repair state observed before the tested handover.

reno.GreetDone.description: Completed Reno greeting; lets the ordinary entry reach his conversation hub.
